content:
Is there a way to change the favicon in a Dataverse site? My university has required branding elements that include an official university favicon that I need to use instead.
I don't see any mention of it in the Style Guide.

@Renee L. you're right, it's not supported. It was requested here: https://github.com/IQSS/dataverse-frontend/issues/259

Please feel free to give that issue a :thumbs_up: or comment or both!
